stem.text: The diagram shows part of a polymer chain.

stem.alt: Structural drawing of part of a polymer chain with vertical bonds: a carbon backbone with H and CN groups drawn above and below each carbon, extending to the right.

stem.text: Which monomer would form this polymer?

A.alt: Structural drawing with vertical bonds: CH2=CH-CN (H above and below the left carbon, H above and CN below the right carbon).

B.alt: Structural drawing with vertical bonds: NC-CH=CH-CN (H and CN on each carbon of the C=C, one above and one below).

C.alt: Structural drawing with vertical bonds: CH2=C(CN)-C(CN)=CH2, a 1,3-diene with CN groups on the two central carbons.

D.alt: Structural drawing with vertical bonds: NC-CH=CH-C(CN)=CH2, a 1,3-diene with CN groups on the first and third carbons.
